title: Mother Nature | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: A hidden goddess emerges from the forest, her profile formed by the leaves, vines, and flowers that surround her. Beside her, a pale river winds between densely textured mountains, drawing the eye into the landscape. Sculpted foliage and metallic highlights reveal a presence that might initially go unnoticed.

title: Blooming Desire | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Cream-colored sculpted flowers rise from intertwining currents of coral, red, and gold, while dark stems and leaves thread through the restless surface.

title: Wild Tiger Lilies | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Bright orange tiger lilies punctuate a dense field of curling textures, their spotted petals unfolding among sculpted leaves. A sweeping gold-toned curve leads through greens, pinks, and shadowed passages, offering glimpses of flowers within the intricate surface.

title: Gilded Bloom | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: A partial bloom extends inward from the edge of the canvas, its golden and copper-toned petals set against layered washes of green, blush pink, and cream. Fine grooves mark the petals, while a rougher central surface creates a contrast in texture. Subtle blue and purple undertones beneath the warmer colors reveal themselves as the light and viewing angle change.

title: A Forest Forgotten | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: A towering tree trunk fills the center of A Forest Forgotten, its deeply worked surface rising beyond the canvas. Around it, sculpted leaves and pale flowers frame glimpses of green forest beneath a sky of pink, gold, and blue. The close viewpoint gives the tree a commanding presence while allowing the surrounding landscape to remain partly concealed.

title: Moss & Mushrooms | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Deep diagonal grooves carry the eye across the bark of an old forest tree. Earthy browns and fine golden highlights trace its ridges, interrupted by vivid patches of green moss. Clusters of sculpted mushrooms project from the surface, their rust-colored tops and pale edges creating small, distinct pauses within the sweeping grain.

title: Ethereal Bloom | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Five sculpted flowers are spaced across a flowing field of pink, green, gold, and deep shadow. Their placement gives the eye points of rest within the elaborate surface, where curling marks gather, unfold, and turn into one another. Metallic highlights trace the raised textures, revealing different details as light moves across the painting.

title: Tiger Lily | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Two orange tiger lilies rise from an intricate surface of evergreen tones, soft pink, and gold. Their spotted petals curl outward, giving the flowers a sculptural presence against the tightly worked background. A winding band of warm color sweeps between them, carrying the glow of sunset through the composition.

title: 75 Leaves | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: A blue-and-gold current, representing the Elbe River, winds through layered passages of green, pink, and metallic texture.

title: Dragon Lily | Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Two sculpted pink lilies emerge from a richly textured field of turquoise, blue, violet, and gold. Their spotted petals curl outward, casting delicate shadows across the flowing surface. A sweeping golden ribbon winds between the blossoms, drawing the eye through layers of metallic color and intricate, wave-like patterns. Small green leaves punctuate the composition, bringing moments of stillness to its movement.

title: Forest & Flowers | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: In Forest & Flowers, sculpted leaves, blossoms, and bark rise from layers of acrylic and organic plaster. As the light shifts, rivers, hidden figures, and metallic traces come into view. These paintings explore love, remembrance, and our dependence on the natural world.

title: Summer Swells | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Summer Swells gathers the pleasures of a beach day into bands of turquoise, white surf, and warm sand. Raised edges give the waves a physical presence, while passages of green and blue suggest water shifting as it approaches the shore. The composition holds the movement of the sea within a clear, open arrangement of color.

title: Manta | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: A spotted ray glides through layered blues, beneath a network of pale lines that recalls light moving across water. The surface shifts from deeper tones to luminous aqua, while sculptural texture gives the surrounding water a sense of depth and motion. Against this active field, the ray appears poised and unhurried.

title: Dark Scales | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Rows of raised scales cover the canvas, catching silver, green, blue, and gold within a darkened surface. Repeated forms create a flowing rhythm, but small variations in their contours and color prevent the pattern from becoming uniform. Light reveals individual marks before drawing them back into the whole.

title: Mermaid Tail | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Pale, iridescent scales extend across Mermaid Tail, their sculpted contours gathering soft greens, blues, pinks, and metallic light. The repeated pattern changes subtly across the surface, creating a shimmer that depends as much on texture as on color. From one passage to another, the painting moves between delicacy and a more tangible, almost armored presence.

title: Beach Day | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Broad diagonal waves cross a bright blue sea, their raised white edges breaking toward a warm stretch of sand. Fine marks scatter through the water, while the sculpted surf gives the composition a strong, rolling rhythm. Beach Day brings the anticipation of reaching the coast into a close view of the shoreline itself.

title: Arctic Waves | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: A narrow line of white surf separates dark, textured water from a bronze-toned shore. Blue gathers along the breaking edge, where small raised marks catch the light and interrupt the darker field. Arctic Waves balances a strong division of color with the restless detail of its surface.

title: Water’s Edge | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Blue water meets a warm shoreline along a raised white edge, where the surf seems to gather before spreading over the sand. Fine streaks and metallic accents animate the sea, while the simpler bands of the beach give the composition a quieter counterpoint. The meeting of these surfaces becomes the painting’s central event.

title: Golden Sand Beach | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Turquoise waves move diagonally toward a broad field of gold, their sculpted white edges catching light above the textured sand. Metallic passages run through the shoreline, bringing the beach’s surface into focus alongside the movement of the water.

title: Sunset Waves | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: An orange sky fades through pink and violet into deep blue above a mass of sculpted waves. Closely drawn ridges curl and overlap across the lower canvas, catching pale and metallic highlights. The smooth transition of the sky contrasts with the dense movement of the water below.

title: Arctic Ocean | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: White waves sweep diagonally through green water toward a dark, deeply textured shore. The strong contrasts give Arctic Ocean an immediate graphic presence, while finer marks within the surf suggest the irregular movement of breaking water. Raised ridges bring light into the composition’s darkest passages.

title: The Oceans | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: A wide shoreline unfolds across The Oceans, with pale aqua water, layered white surf, and bands of warm sand. Its horizontal format allows the eye to travel along the coast, following small variations in the breaking waves. Sculptural texture gives substance to a scene associated with continuous change.

title: The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: The Oceans explores the sea through sculptural texture, shifting color, and personal memory. Shorelines, rolling waves, and imagined scales connect the pleasure of a beach day with curiosity about life beneath the surface. Across the collection, familiar coastal experiences open into questions of endurance, adventure, and responsibility. Each painting approaches the water differently, preserving both the intimacy of an individual encounter and the sense of a world extending beyond what we can see.

title: Carnations | The Regal Collection | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Pink, green, ivory, and gold gather in flowing, sculpted forms. Curving ridges give the surface a floral rhythm, bringing softness and strength into the same composition.

title: Navy | The Regal Collection | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Long ridges sweep through deep navy, teal, ivory, and gold. Their changing direction gives the surface a current of movement, with light catching the raised edges.

title: Sahara | The Regal Collection | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Gold and ivory move diagonally through dark passages, building a surface that feels layered and weathered. Small scattered marks interrupt the longer strokes.

title: Verdant | The Regal Collection | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Deep greens and metallic gold weave through an intricate field of sculpted curls. Raised contours catch the light like glimpses through a canopy.

title: Ciaran | The Regal Collection | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: Green, pink, ivory, and gold move through ornamental curves, their raised contours giving the painting a sense of layered movement.

title: The Regal Collection | Vudi Phothisuk Art
description: A journey through memory and emotion, expressed in sculptural texture, shifting color, and metallic light.
